typography.$description: Three-tier typography for Prada Beauty x AKQA. Primitives → semantic → component. Values mirror the live PDP type styles captured in Figma 535:6303 (prada/Semantic/* and www.prada.com/Semantic/*). Sizes in rem (1rem = 16px) so web translates directly; px equivalents in $description for native iOS/Android sp/dp mapping.

primitives.$description: Tier 1 — raw values. No semantic meaning. Use only inside semantic tokens.

fallback.$description: System fallback stack for environments where Inter hasn't loaded.

semantic.$description: Tier 2 — usage tokens. Each composes a primitive set into a re-usable typography object. Component tokens reference these.

lg.$description: Hero / landing heroes. Live PDP Heading 2 (23.3 / 28, Medium, +0.2 tracking).

h1.$description: Page title (PDP product name). Live PDP Heading 1 (19.5 / 24, Medium, +0.2 tracking).

h2.$description: Section title (accordion header). Live PDP Inter Medium (15.3 / 24).

h3.$description: Sub-section heading. Live PDP Heading 3 (13.5 / 18, Medium).

h4-upper.$description: Uppercase eyebrow heading (rendered with text-transform: uppercase). Live PDP Heading 4 upper (11.8 / 14, Medium, +0.2 tracking).

lg.$description: Primary body copy. Live PDP Inter Regular (15.1 / 22).

md.$description: Default body — formulation / care benefits. Live PDP Semantic Item (14 / 20).

sm.$description: Compact body (legal / disclaimer paragraphs). Live PDP Semantic Label (13.1 / 18).

default.$description: Form labels and meta labels. Live PDP Semantic Label.

small.$description: Helper text under labels. Live PDP Semantic Link.

lg.$description: Primary CTA — Add to shopping bag. Live PDP Semantic Button upper (14 / 16, Medium, +0.2 tracking, uppercase).

sm.$description: Secondary buttons. Live PDP Inter Medium upper (12 / 14, Medium, +0.2 tracking).

default.$description: Inline links — Find in store, Shop refill, Notify me. Live PDP Semantic Link (11.3 / 18).

underline.$description: Underlined link variant. Live PDP Inter Regular underline (13.3 / 21, +0.2 tracking).

upper.$description: Uppercase link (footer nav). Live PDP Semantic Link upper.

default.$description: Tiny uppercase category tag (e.g. "NEW" / "EXCLUSIVE"). Live PDP Semantic Item upper (10.8 / 16.5, Medium, +0.2 tracking).
Product price meta / image captions. Live PDP Inter Medium title (11.6 / 18).

component.$description: Tier 3 — component-level overrides. Each component references the semantic tokens. Add new entries here as new components are scoped.

price.$description: PDP price (£ 52). Defaults to body-lg; can be re-pointed to a price-specific style if needed.

section-heading.$description: Accordion headers — Product details, Free shipping and returns.

shade-label.$description: "Color: LC10 - LIGHT COOL" label above shade chips.

primary-cta.$description: Add to shopping bag button label.

secondary-action.$description: Start personalization / Find in store / Shop refill / Notify me when available.

breadcrumb.$description: Prada / Perfumes and beauty / Beauty / Face.

input-label.$description: Notify-me email label, size selector label.

input-text.$description: Typed value inside notify-me / size selector inputs.

spacing.$description: Spacing tokens. Three-tier: primitives (raw px values) → scale (clean 4px base ladder) → pdp (live PDP item-spacings captured in Figma 535:6303). Component tokens reference scale or pdp depending on which the layout demands.

primitives.$description: Tier 1 — raw px values. No layout meaning. Used inside scale and pdp tokens.

27.$description: Live PDP item spacing/27 — not on the clean scale.

scale.$description: Tier 2 — clean 4px-base scale. Default usage in new components. Use t-shirt sizes for readability; px-named primitives are the source of truth.

pdp.$description: Tier 2-alt — live PDP item-spacings captured in Figma 535:6303 (item spacing/xs, /xxs, /s+, /m, /10, /11, /12, /20, /27, /40). References scale.* where values match exactly, primitives.* where they don't.

27.$description: 27px — Figma item spacing/27 (off the 4px scale, layout-specific)

40.$description: 40px — Figma item spacing/40 (between scale.xl 32 and scale.2xl 48; kept on the primitive)
